[roster setup=A task=T32]

HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.
- Tests: `bun test <your test path>` must pass and `bun test` (whole suite) must not regress. Never modify existing tests
  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.

TASK T32 · W4 · Register the acceptance, forward and run commands
GOAL: `roster acceptance`, `roster forward` and `roster run` work from the CLI. Their modules exist, but src/cli.ts only registers
`review`.
READ: src/cli.ts, src/cli/acceptance.ts (acceptanceCommand), src/cli/forward.ts (forwardCommand), src/cli/run.ts (runRun, its
import.meta.main block).
OWNS: src/cli.ts, src/cli/run.ts (only to export a `runCommand: Command` wrapper if it lacks one), tests/cli-registry.test.ts
BUILD: Register acceptanceCommand, forwardCommand and a run command in COMMANDS; `roster --help` lists all four; unknown commands still
print usage and exit 2 (or the current code).
ACCEPTANCE: tests/cli-registry.test.ts asserts the four names are registered, each has summary and usage, and `bun src/cli.ts
acceptance --help` exits 0 with usage text. Whole suite green, typecheck clean.
TEST: bun test tests/cli-registry.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.

input.command: cat src/cli.ts; echo ----; grep -n "export\|Command\|import.meta.main" -n src/cli/acceptance.ts src/cli/forward.ts src/cli/run.ts | head -60; ls tests | head -50; which entire
input.description: Read CLI entry and command modules

input.command: sed -n 100,130p src/cli/run.ts; sed -n 40,70p src/cli/acceptance.ts; sed -n 60,90p src/cli/forward.ts; grep -n "import.meta.main" src/cli/*.ts; entire graph impact --symbol COMMANDS --json 2>&1 | head -20
